$comment: Project-specific anti-patterns: conventions of THIS design system's API that are accessibility-relevant but invisible to any generic tool. Same schema as the base catalogue. Over time this file becomes the accumulated value of the agent on a given project.

antiPatterns.name: Bare <input> not wrapped in FormField
antiPatterns.judgmentQuestion: Is this raw <input> rendered inside the FormField component, or is FormField itself the file under review? FormField's own internal <input> is correct. Any other bare <input> bypasses the automatic label/id association and the aria-invalid handling.
antiPatterns.why: FormField generates the label/input association, the unique id, and the aria-invalid / aria-describedby wiring. A bare input silently opts out of all three, and the omission is invisible in review.
antiPatterns.fix: Wrap the input in <FormField label="...">, or use the <Input> component, which is always rendered inside one.

antiPatterns.name: Modal used without a triggerRef
antiPatterns.judgmentQuestion: Does this <Modal> usage pass a triggerRef? Without it the modal cannot restore focus to the element that opened it, and the keyboard user is returned to the top of the document on close.
antiPatterns.why: On close, focus must return to the trigger. Without the ref the user is dropped at the start of the page and loses their position entirely.
antiPatterns.fix: Store a ref on the triggering button and pass it: <Modal triggerRef={buttonRef} … />

antiPatterns.name: Toast rendered outside ToastProvider
antiPatterns.judgmentQuestion: Is this Toast rendered through the ToastProvider's live region, or mounted directly? Only the provider holds a persistent live region; a directly mounted Toast announces nothing.
antiPatterns.why: The persistent live region lives in ToastProvider. A Toast mounted outside it renders visually but is never announced to screen readers.
antiPatterns.fix: Trigger toasts through the useToast() hook so the message is injected into the provider's persistent region.

examples.good: const showToast = useToast(); showToast({ message: 'Saved', kind: 'success' });
